'''''AT-AT Villa''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]]<ref name="Celestia Galactica Photografica" /> created after [[104 ABY]]<ref name="Date" /> that depicted two modified [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]] on a [[Grass/Legends|grassy]] and artificially ringed world with thin towering rock formations. The two AT-ATs had wing-like extensions on their sides to support numerous round buildings, both on top of the vehicle and extending beneath the extensions. The most prominent of the AT-ATs also had a bowl structure that contained more buildings hanging from each side of the extensions. Below the vehicles, a group of [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] in blue robes guided a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] onto a small landing platform. Below them, an alien on a red [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] conversed with a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] and an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]].<ref name="Celestia Galactica Photografica">{{StoryCite|story=Celestia Galactica Photografica|book=Star Wars: Visionaries}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''AT-AT Villa'' appeared in "[[Celestia Galactica Photografica]]," a collection of [[in-universe]] illustrations by [[Ryan Church]] collected in ''[[Star Wars: Visionaries]]'', a [[2005]] [[Wikipedia:Graphic novel|graphic novel]] edited by [[Jeremy Barlow]].<ref name="Celestia Galactica Photografica" />
